extDescription.message: Show selected websites in grayscale. Choose the sites and the level of gray.

commandToggleSite.message: Make the current site gray or remove the gray

popupUnsupported.message: The browser does not let extensions change this page.

popupAllSitesMode.message: All sites are gray (mode: all sites)

rulesIntro.message: GrayWeb checks the rules from top to bottom. The first rule that matches the page decides.

modeNoteListed.message: Mode: only the listed sites are gray. Change it in General.

modeNoteAll.message: Mode: all sites are gray, except the exceptions. Change it in General.

testByMode.message: no rule matches, mode is all sites

rulesReorderFiltered.message: Clear the search and the filters to change the order of the rules.

rulesEmptyText.message: Add a rule here, or open a website and use the GrayWeb button in the toolbar.

rulesMoveHandle.message: Move rule. Use the arrow keys.

matchDomainHelp.message: Matches the domain and all its subdomains.

matchHostHelp.message: Matches this host name only, not other subdomains.

matchPrefixHelp.message: Matches all URLs that start with this text. Without a scheme, http and https both match.

matchExactHelp.message: Matches this page only. The query and the fragment are ignored.

matchWildcardHelp.message: * matches any text, ? matches one character. The full URL must match.

matchRegexHelp.message: JavaScript regular expression, tested on the full URL.

matchContainsHelp.message: Matches all URLs that contain this text. Uppercase and lowercase are the same.

matchPathHelp.message: Matches this path and its subfolders on any site.

editorOwnSettings.message: Use own settings for this rule

editorSlowRegex.message: This regular expression is very slow on some URLs. It can make pages slow.

error_tooLong.message: The pattern is too long (maximum 500 characters).

error_invalidHost.message: This is not a valid host name.

error_invalidUrl.message: This is not a valid URL.

error_invalidPath.message: The path must start with / and must not contain spaces, ? or #.

error_invalidRegex.message: This regular expression is not valid.

appearanceIntro.message: These settings apply to all sites. A rule can have its own settings.

previewText.message: Images, buttons and text show the result of the settings.

presetsIntro.message: Apply a preset to the global settings, or save the current values as a new preset.

generalEnabledHelp.message: When off, GrayWeb does not change any page.

modeListedHelp.message: Sites are gray only when a rule matches them.

modeAllHelp.message: All sites are gray. Use exception rules for the sites that must stay in color.

generalLanguageHelp.message: The language of the GrayWeb interface.

generalShortcutValue.message: $1 makes the current site gray or removes the gray.

generalShortcutFirefox.message: To change it, open the add-ons manager and select Manage Extension Shortcuts.

syncOk.message: Your settings are synchronized with your browser account.

syncQuota.message: Your settings are too large to synchronize. They are kept on this device only.

syncUnavailable.message: Synchronization is not available. Your settings are kept on this device only.

syncPending.message: Synchronization starts after the first change.

exportHelp.message: Save your rules and settings in a JSON file.

importHelp.message: Load rules and settings from a JSON file.

importSummary.message: The file contains $1 rules and $2 presets.

importChoice.message: Replace removes your current rules. Merge adds only the new rules.

importNotJson.message: it is not a JSON file

resetHelp.message: Delete all rules and presets and use the default settings.

resetConfirm.message: All rules and presets will be deleted. Export a backup first if you need them.

aboutText.message: Open-source extension released under the MIT license.

privacyText.message: GrayWeb does not collect, keep or send any data. It makes no network requests. Your rules stay in your browser and, if you use it, in the synchronization of your browser account.

permissionHosts.message: Applies the filter before the page appears, so you do not see a flash of color. GrayWeb does not read the content of pages.
